Google Tech Talks
January 24, 2007

ABSTRACT

Every day around the world, software developers spend much of their time working with a variety of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs). Some are integral to the core platform, some provide access to widely distributed frameworks, and some are written in-house for use by a few developers. Nice article.
I'd also highly recommend "How To Design A Good API and Why it Matters" video from Joshua Bloch (co-author of Java).
He digs much deeper, mostly at code level rather than JSON level but the same principles apply.
Even though this video is almost 20 years old, the topics are as significant today as they were back then.
